The bone marrow of the skeletal system decreases the production of platelets being released into the circulatory system, preventing clots from disrupting blood flow.
The nervous system increases body temperature, causing the amount of $O_2$ taken in by the lungs of the respiratory system to decrease, preventing the formation of blood clots.
explanation:

Passage Excerpt: 'Platelets are a component of blood that are formed within the marrow of bones... They help with the clotting of blood.'

Why: The skeletal system (bone marrow) produces platelets which enter the circulatory system. To protect against fatal blood clots while blood flow slows during hibernation, the squirrel's body drastically reduces platelet production.
